### Finding Favor - Truth For Life - August 27
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-27-2024.html
Passage: Genesis 6:8
Points:
- Noah was an ordinary man who was part of a fallen, sinful human race.
- God's unmerited favor intervened against impending judgment and distinguished Noah.
- Grace is not unique to the New Testament; it flows throughout Old Testament history.
- True grace humbles the believer and produces active obedience to God's commands.
- Walking faithfully amid cultural decline stems entirely from God's gracious intervention.

### Finding God’s Favor in the Darkest of Times
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-november-28.html
Passage: Genesis 6:8
Points:
- Noah walked blamelessly with God despite living surrounded by widespread wickedness.
- God grieves over human sinfulness but remains patient, desiring repentance.
- A believer's daily actions matter to God, who actively watches for those seeking Him.
- God calls His followers to practice justice, defend the vulnerable, and walk humbly.
- Through Christ's strength, believers can live righteously in dark times.
